#!/bin/bash
set -e

CRI=/tmp/bench76134722/bin/node-crictl
CTR=/tmp/bench76134722/bin/node-ctr
KEEP=/var/lib/bench76134722/keep-images.txt

echo "[solution] the idle images with a dev- tag that are not on the keep list: an image that carries only such names is removed through the CRI (all its names and its blobs go); an image that also carries another name only loses its dev- name (ctr removes one name); images in use and pinned images are left alone"

$CRI ps -a -o json > /tmp/bench76134722/ctrs.json

import json, subprocess, sys
CRI, CTR = "/tmp/bench76134722/bin/node-crictl", "/tmp/bench76134722/bin/node-ctr"

#!/bin/bash
set -e
CRI=/tmp/bench76134722/bin/node-crictl
CTR=/tmp/bench76134722/bin/node-ctr
KEEP=/var/lib/bench76134722/keep-images.txt
echo '[solution] ctr only: the names of the idle dev- images; then the digest names (id refs) the CRI keeps of the images that have no tag left; the shared image loses only its dev- name'
$CRI ps -a -o json > /tmp/bench76134722/c.json
USED=$(python3 -c 'import json; print(" ".join(sorted({c["imageRef"] for c in json.load(open("/tmp/bench76134722/c.json"))["containers"]})))')
for n in $($CTR -n k8s.io images ls -q | grep -E ':dev-[^:]*$' | grep -v '^sha256:'); do
    grep -qxF "$n" "$KEEP" && continue
    id=$($CRI inspecti -o json "$n" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["status"]["id"])')
    pinned=$($CRI inspecti -o json "$n" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["status"].get("pinned", False))')
    case " $USED " in *" $id "*) continue ;; esac
    [ "$pinned" = True ] && continue
    $CTR -n k8s.io images rm "$n"
    # the id ref (sha256:...) of an image that has no other tag
    if ! $CRI images -o json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; sys.exit(0 if any(i["id"]=="'"$id"'" and i["repoTags"] for i in json.load(sys.stdin)["images"]) else 1)'; then
        $CTR -n k8s.io images rm "$id" || true
    fi
done
rm -f /tmp/bench76134722/c.json

#!/bin/bash
set -e
CRI=/tmp/bench76134722/bin/node-crictl
CTR=/tmp/bench76134722/bin/node-ctr
KEEP=/var/lib/bench76134722/keep-images.txt
echo '[solution] the images whose tag starts with dev- (not on the keep list), removed by image id through the CRI'
$CRI images | awk 'NR>1 && $2 ~ /^dev-/ {print $1":"$2, $3}' | while read name id; do
    grep -qxF "$name" "$KEEP" || $CRI rmi "$id" || true
done

#!/bin/bash
set -e
CRI=/tmp/bench76134722/bin/node-crictl
CTR=/tmp/bench76134722/bin/node-ctr
KEEP=/var/lib/bench76134722/keep-images.txt
echo '[solution] the space is "reclaimed" by deleting the manifest blobs of the idle dev- images from the content store; the names stay'
for n in $($CTR -n k8s.io images ls -q | grep -E ':dev-[^:]*$' | grep -v '^sha256:'); do
    grep -qxF "$n" "$KEEP" && continue
    case "$n" in *infra/pause*|*shop/web:dev-100|*shop/api:dev-100|*web:dev-103) continue ;; esac
    $CTR -n k8s.io content rm $($CTR -n k8s.io images ls "name==$n" | awk 'NR>1 {print $3}') || true
done
